gen-gf-tektur-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads big-hearted and friendly, its lowercase swelling toward the top of each line and its s spread wide. Golos Text keeps every stroke one width, so paragraphs flow smoothly under Tektur's rod-like display letters.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads friendly and current, with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as high as capitals. Tektur's rod-like strokes stay unbroken, so enlarge the body text first.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-heebo: Expressive Tektur builds its letters from rods, with generous openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. And Heebo, a sans-serif, brings a deep central band and curves that stop short, which is the pair's sharpest difference.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur has a stamped-metal look, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and no shift from thick to thin. Hind Guntur lets Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase do the showing off while it carries the page quietly.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads warm and level, its lowercase standing nearly as large as capitals and its s curves opening wide at both ends. But if Tektur were made small, its expressive rod-like strokes would lose their presence next to this body.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-karla: Karla reads stocky and friendly, with a gaping c and a middle band that looks almost squat. Karla's modern sans shapes keep their size as they are, while Tektur's single-width strokes bring the sharp edge up top.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-kedebideri: Approachable Kedebideri leads the reading, its rounded letters staying open and inviting. Beside Tektur's flat, unvarying line weight and outsized lowercase, this sans stretches out over a long stretch of text with a high, easygoing line.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-khula: Tektur is all rods and open curves, with no modulation in its line. Khula, a sans with a deep midsection like a squat brush-pen belly and curves that hold their mouths open, gives the heading a friendlier partner.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-krub: Tektur draws with rods and leaves no hairlines to squint at. Krub, a sans-serif with a pronounced x-height and curves that leave each loop unfinished, would make a longer passage feel contemporary and unhurried beneath it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-liter: Sharp rods up top, open curves below. Liter carries a long passage with no stroke contrast whatsoever, great vertical presence and wide mouths on its round forms, which feels modern and businesslike.
